title: Only Burn Halfway Down
text:
Only Burn Halfway Down. I've used 6 of these and in every case, they only burn halfway down. You can't get them to re-light.
The scent is barely noticeable. It was a waste of money. I bought them because they had the same scent name as a major brand, but they disappointed me in every way. Not worth the time or effort for a half-life product.
